notes: Sunday 07:00 BRT = 10:00 UTC; Sunday 09:00 BRT = 12:00 UTC.
Stack is an OCI Container Instance (OCIR image) — no boot volume.
Robot drains Cloudflare Queues 2-at-a-time until empty, then self-deletes.
Terraform destroy at 09:00 BRT has absolute authority even if messages remain.
Local and GHA must share OCI Object Storage Terraform state (TF_BACKEND_HCL_B64).
